node.content-desc: IB. Curriculum: -based, concept-led, and interdisciplinary with programmes such as MYP and DP designed around global-minded learning.. Assessment: Uses a mix of internal and external assessment; MYP external assessment is optional and DP adds essays, projects, and other coursework-heavy elements.. Subject flexibility: Greater flexibility, especially in subject choice and in how learners connect disciplines.. Transferability: Best when moving between international schools; recognition is global, but local can depend on school level and mapping.
